tools.name: agent_os_task_create
tools.description: Create an AgentTask on the board. New tasks start `ready` (dispatchable now) unless you defer them: pass scheduledFor for a timed start (→ `scheduled`) or dependsOnTaskIds to gate on upstream work (→ `waiting`); both auto-promote to `ready` when their gate clears. Idempotent within the AgentOS: pass idempotencyKey (or requestId) from the foreground turn so a Telegram retry or Ghost restart returns the existing task instead of spawning a duplicate. Response includes `created` (false = an existing task was returned). Harness implementation slices whose titles begin Implement, Resume, Continue, or Finish require parentTaskId even when planId is present; create or reuse a feature parent first. Do NOT create closeout-only bookkeeping tasks whose purpose is merely to close/reconcile/clean up another task — complete/update/block/cancel the existing task (or spawn a child only for genuine unresolved implementation work).

title.description: Short task title (required). Never a closeout-only sweep — mutate/close the existing task instead.

priority.description: Priority is a worker-capacity queue signal, not importance. Default 'normal' (cleanup 'low'). Do NOT inherit plan/goal priority. Use 'high' only when harness workers are saturated and ready work waits for slots. Use 'critical' only for live production/security incidents — pass priorityEscalationReason or cite in title/description. When slots are free, omit priority and dispatch at normal. The API downgrades importance-style high/critical.

priorityEscalationReason.description: Required for critical: quote the requesting user or name the live production/security incident. High does not use this field — high requires worker-capacity contention at create time.

executor.description: How the task runs: inline | harness | acp | manual.

executorRef.description: Opaque ref to the executor process / unit.

parentTaskId.description: Feature-parent task id. Required for harness implementation slices whose title begins Implement, Resume, Continue, or Finish, including plan-linked slices.

planId.description: AgentPlan id to link this task to; required for plan-scoped harness work. This does not replace parentTaskId for implementation slices.

planStageId.description: Optional AgentPlan stage id for finer plan lineage.

personaSlug.description: Lane-expert worker slug to attribute the task to, or null to clear/filter unassigned tasks.

scheduledFor.description: ISO-8601 timestamp to defer the task to. A future time creates the task as `scheduled`; the operator loop auto-promotes it to `ready` once the time passes. null clears the schedule.

dependsOnTaskIds.description: Upstream task ids this task waits on. Creates the task as `waiting`; the operator loop auto-promotes it to `ready` once every listed task is `done` (a failed/cancelled upstream keeps it waiting).

tools.name: agent_os_macro_controls_get
tools.description:
Fetch the current macro/social trend snapshot so you can adapt marketing content to active signals.

WHEN TO CALL: before generating social media posts, ad copy, campaign briefs, launch announcements,
trend-reactive content, or any marketing material where current events could affect brand perception.
This is an on-demand catch-up step — call it at the START of social/content/marketing work, not on
every message.

WHAT YOU GET: a compact MacroControlSnapshot with active MacroTrendSignals (topic, sensitivity,
summary, confidence, sourceLinks), a globalSensitivity aggregate ('safe'|'cautious'|'sensitive'|'blocked'),
isStale flag, and agentGuidance text you should incorporate into your content plan.

GATING RULES:
- globalSensitivity='blocked': do NOT publish related content — surface the blocked topics to the
  operator and wait for explicit approval before proceeding.
- globalSensitivity='sensitive': draft with extra care, avoid direct references to flagged topics,
  prefer evergreen angles, and flag for human review before posting.
- globalSensitivity='cautious': note flagged topics in your plan; adjust tone but may proceed.
- globalSensitivity='safe' or isStale=true with no signals: proceed with standard brand voice.

If isStale=true AND signals are present, treat the data as advisory only and note staleness in your
output so the operator knows to refresh. Read-only; safe for unattended invocation.
